BiblicalUsage: Jehudi is an Israelite, the prince who read Jeremiah's scroll to Jehoiakim. In Jeremiah 36:14, Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah. The fuller story is told on the Jehudi profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jehudi matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
